q-question-088: reuse specific workflows from previous tasks

plan.cost: Expected ~$0.80 pilot and ~$3.00 full (uncached prices; both passes of a query are sent back to back, so real billing may be lower from prompt caching). Judge <= $0.20.
diagnostics_not_gates: nDCG by query type (keyword expected to gain most)
facet count distribution and share of capped papers
source paper flagged as missing a facet (evaluation-only proxy for extraction or checking errors; never used in ranking)
plan.facets: 1-4 per query, extracted once from query text only and shared by both scoring passes.
plan.hypothesis: An explicit per-query requirement checklist, with a code-enforced cap for papers missing a requirement, ranks direct answers above partial topical matches better than one holistic score.
plan.labels: shared-labels/labels-d46.json plus a child layer of judge-graded top10 fills (frozen judge, human overrides preserved).
plan.multiple_comparisons: Two systems from the same responses; a secondary-only qualifier is reported as such and needs a fresh confirmation before promotion.
plan.one_change: Scoring prompt/schema adds the facet checklist and per-paper missing IDs; code caps papers with any missing facet at 2. Everything else as Decision46.

pilot_gate.note: The pilot queries informed earlier designs and the loss analysis saw all 100 dev queries, so the gate is a sanity screen, not evidence.

qualifies_if.consistency: nDCG delta vs reference > 0 on both pilot20 and new80
qualifies_if.ndcg@10_delta_vs_reference: > 0.0106 (conservative single-pass MDD of the safeguard; two-pass noise unmeasured) with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

stages.full: Other 80 dev queries: 80 extraction + 160 scoring requests; only if the pilot gate passed and the user approved.
stages.pilot: 20 pilot dev queries: 20 extraction + 40 scoring requests.
